description: Punctuation variants that do NOT alter clause boundaries.

candidate_sets.pattern: sentence-initial connective (Thus/Therefore/Hence/So/Then/Next/Now) followed by optional comma

terminal period boundary of a short standalone equation/result line followed by a line break; the site begins immediately before the optional final period and includes the existing line break; the equation/result body is invariant left context and is not part of the matched span
candidate_sets.note: Only when the line is a complete standalone step ending in a value or expression; never when the period disambiguates sentence structure. <linebreak> is the actual existing line terminator in the trace and is included in forced-candidate scoring. Lines at EOF without a following line break are conservatively skipped. Interior operators remain eligible for rule 06. Amended at pre-freeze review per REVIEW_LOG F2 (defect and amendment proposed by Fable, adopted wording by Sol, applied 2026-08-07).

exclusions: colon/semicolon swaps — EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED per freeze
any comma whose presence/absence changes clause attachment or list structure
serial/Oxford commas — EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED per freeze
decimal points, thousands separators, or any numeral-internal punctuation
